main.description: **Legal-person debtor** が restructuring rite に opt-in。**debtorEntityType MUST be one of legal-person classes** — yobel との対称: yobel は natural_person のみ、amnesty は法人のみ。schema レベル enum で gate。

debtorEntityType.description: MUST be a legal-person entity class. natural_person is INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED — natural-person debt is yobel's scope. amnesty cell DMN A14 also verifies the resolved CouncilSBT entityType claim matches.

debtorJurisdictionIso3.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3. For sovereign debtors, the debtor's own jurisdiction. For corporate debtors, the jurisdiction of incorporation.

legalRepresentationDid.description: DID of the law firm / counsel representing the debtor (typically vendor:lawfirm.etzhayyim.com or equivalent). Required for corporate_chapter_11 + corporate_workout rite types.

totalLiabilitiesMicroUsdc.description: Debtor's total outstanding liabilities at enrollment time, in micro-USDC. Used to compute creditor class voting share denominators.

filingDocumentCid.description: IPFS CID of the formal filing document (Chapter 11 petition / scheme of arrangement / HIPC participation request)

deferToYobel.description: True if A14 fires (entity type resolution returned natural_person) → caller should route to yobel.etzhayyim.com instead
